verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents multiple explicit speed/latency-focused capabilities: 'Fast' serverless variants for latency-sensitive workloads, on-demand dedicated GPUs with lower latency/higher throughput and predictable performance, sticky-routing for prompt-cache hits, priority service tier, fast autoscaling with minimal cold starts, and an open-source benchmarking tool to measure/optimize performance. This directly matches the story's TTFT and high-throughput needs with first-party docs. One community report criticizes pricing/cost-efficiency of fine-tuning (unrelated to inference latency claims) so it doesn't contradict the speed claims. Missing for 10: independent hands-on latency/throughput benchmarks or third-party corroboration of the claimed performance numbers.
